description: React component for user management dashboard, including user list, editing, deletion, bulk actions, and settings.

classes.name: ViewUserDashboardProps
classes.description: Props interface for the user dashboard component.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets user to delete and opens delete modal.

methods.name: useEffect (fetch user models)
methods.description: Fetches available user models for bulk editing.

methods.name: updateFilters
methods.description: Updates filter state and debounced filters.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Generates password reset link and shows modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes user and updates user list.

methods.name: handleEditCancel
methods.description: Closes edit modal and clears selected user.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Saves edited user data and updates list.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Changes current page for user list.

methods.name: handleToggleSelectionMode
methods.description: Enables or disables user selection mode.

methods.name: handleBulkEdit
methods.description: Opens bulk edit modal for selected users.

methods.name: handleBulkEditSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes user list after bulk edit.
